items.t: How to read the MLS 55+ flag

faq.q: Can I rent out a 55+ unit in Langley?
faq.a: Whether a unit can be rented depends on the strata's current bylaws and the provincial rules that apply to them, and many 55+ buildings restrict rentals. Ask for the bylaws and the strata minutes before you buy a unit in Langley as an investment.

faq.q: What does 55+ mean for a home in Langley?
faq.a: Most 55+ strata communities in BC set an age rule in their bylaws, commonly that at least one resident is 55 or older, and many also limit children and rentals. The rules differ from one building to the next, so read the bylaws and the Form B Information Certificate before you make an offer on a unit in Langley.
